Class SocketServerConnection

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Network.Connection.Socket.SocketServerConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerConnection
public class SocketServerConnection extends Object implements ServerConnection
TCP-based implementation of ServerConnection used by the client.

This class owns the socket, the object streams, and a background reader thread that continuously drains messages from the server into an internal queue. The public API exposes synchronous request/response operations for lobby commands and fire-and-forget methods for in-game actions.

Threading model

  • The calling thread performs writes through a synchronized lock so ObjectOutputStream access remains serialized.
  • A dedicated reader thread is started after a match is created or joined; it forwards every incoming object to responseQueue.
  • receive() blocks on that queue and returns the next server message to the controller.

    • createMatch

      public JoinResult createMatch(String matchName, String nickname) throws Exception
      Creates a new match and waits for the server join result.

      If the server replies with an ErrorMessage, it is translated to an IOException. On success, the background reader thread is started so asynchronous game updates can be received.

      Specified by:
      createMatch in interface ServerConnection
      Parameters:
      matchName - name of the new match to create
      nickname - player's nickname to register in the match
      Returns:
      the join result produced by the server
      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection fails or the server rejects the request with an error message

      public void sendAction(Object action)
